outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows representative phase-contrast micrographs, not a quantitative plot; individual data points are not applicable.

The bottom bar graph in panel C reports mean ± SEM (n=3) percentages, and the individual replicate values are overlaid on the bars as distinct point markers (circles, squares, triangles) for each condition/category.
The bottom bar graph in panel D reports mean ± SD (n=3), and individual data points for each of the three replicates are plotted over each bar.
The heatmap displays each of the three biological replicates as a separate row per condition, so individual replicate values are shown rather than only an averaged value.
Panel F is a representative western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Both bar graphs in panel G show mean ± SEM (n=3) relative mRNA levels with individual replicate data points (circles, squares, triangles) plotted over each bar.
Panel H shows representative immunofluorescence images, not a quantitative plot; individual data points are not applicable.
